stories.title: Russian Missile and Drone Barrage Kills at Least 17 in Kyiv, Strikes Spill Into Romania and Moldova
stories.summary: Russia launched a large-scale missile and drone barrage against Kyiv early Thursday, killing at least 17 people and wounding dozens more, according to Ukrainian officials. The strikes damaged a children's hospital, an apartment building, and several warehouses across multiple districts of the capital. Romania said a Russian-launched, explosive-laden naval drone struck one of its offshore Black Sea gas platforms the same day. The barrage came as Kyiv's air defenses face dwindling supplies of interceptors for its US-made Patriot systems.

stories.title: Trump Announces 'Crushing' Economic Warfare Campaign Against Iran
stories.summary: President Donald Trump announced what he called the 'most crushing economic operation ever taken against any country' against Iran, threatening 'tremendous economic consequences' for any nation, bank, or company that continues doing business with Tehran. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the US would impose 'maximum economic pressure,' targeting oil smuggling networks, exchange houses, and ship registries. Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi rejected the threat as 'economic terrorism.' The move extends the administration's 'Operation Economic Fury' campaign against Iran, underway since April.

stories.title: US Stocks Fall as Iran Threat Lifts Oil Prices and Reverses Bond Rally
stories.summary: US stocks fell Thursday after President Trump's threat to escalate economic pressure on Iran pushed oil prices higher and reversed a bond-market rally from the prior session. The Dow Jones Industrial Average dropped 0.8%, the S&P 500 slipped 0.3%, and the Nasdaq Composite fell 0.8%. Brent crude climbed toward $94 a barrel, while 30-year Treasury yields rose even after the Treasury Department flagged plans for larger debt buybacks. Walmart shares fell more than 9% after the retailer reported slowing US sales growth despite beating earnings estimates.

stories.title: Cerebras Unveils CS-4 Rack-Scale AI Inference System, Claims 30x Faster Than GPUs
stories.summary: Cerebras Systems unveiled the CS-4, a rack-scale AI inference system combining three of its WSE-3 Turbo wafer-scale chips, at a launch event in San Francisco. The company said the system delivers up to 750 petaflops of AI compute and processes more than 4,400 tokens per second per user on the GPT-OSS-120B model, versus roughly 350 tokens per second on the fastest comparable GPU-based service. Cerebras said a new modular design cuts component count by half versus its prior generation and claims up to 30 times faster inference than GPU-based systems. First CS-4 shipments are scheduled to begin later this quarter.

stories.title: Lab Experiment Resolves 20-Year Mystery of How Diamond Melts Under Extreme Pressure
stories.summary: Researchers at Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory used laser-driven shock compression at the University of Rochester's Omega Laser Facility to measure how diamond melts at pressures three times greater than Earth's core, matching conditions inside Neptune and Uranus. New X-ray diffraction measurements resolved a 20-year discrepancy between lab data and theoretical models, showing earlier melting-temperature readings had been off by more than 1,000 degrees. The findings, published in Nature Physics, show diamond keeps its crystal structure until it melts directly into liquid carbon, without an intermediate phase seen in some earlier experiments. The results could let fusion researchers at LLNL's National Ignition Facility use slower initial shocks in diamond fuel capsules, potentially tripling fusion energy yield, while refining models of planetary interiors.
